closed_findings: The original standalone private callsite audit omitted only the A/B offset-identity field; it was regenerated host-only and now exactly equals both the current audit and the unchanged frozen intent audit without changing any SOURCE_KEY or candidate byte.

A preliminary reviewer STOP claiming 0x4001 and 0x6001 publication details were unreachable was withdrawn: the materialized P2.88 classifier accepts the 0x4001-0x4fff and 0x6001-0x6fff FAILURE bands before exact-detail and terminal rules, and current endpoint/precedence tests cover that behavior.
A preliminary reviewer STOP claiming all P3.03 contradiction details were unreachable was withdrawn for the same verified publication-band reason.

A marker-only synthetic stock baseline gap was closed by a dedicated exact-target D0 producer, raw boot-window receipt, actual runtime module SHA-256 receipt, immutable baseline binding, and exact same-campaign comparison whenever that optional pair is supplied.

The attended multi-target inventory bug was closed in the D0 producer: exactly one state=device model:SM_S906N device:g0q row is selected while unrelated rows are permitted; zero or duplicate S22 matches fail closed; final serial and row count are compared before any final topology or property command, and a replacement-S22 test proves zero commands reach the foreign serial.

The first connected D0 exposed a host observer-ordering bug when stock dmesg normalization rejected its timestamps before the raw input was preserved. The corrected producer durably creates the exact bounded private raw immediately after the read and only then invokes normalization, so a repeated parser failure preserves evidence without changing target selection, target commands, candidate bytes, or evidence schema.

The preserved Samsung toybox dmesg proved that each timestamped line may begin with an ANSI SGR prefix. The binding now accepts zero or more line-anchored ESC-[digits-or-semicolons]-m prefixes before the unchanged priority/timestamp grammar. Matching remains bounded by the existing 16 MiB raw cap and deterministic SGR terminator, while verify_payloads still hashes the exact raw and independently reruns the same boot-window and normalization checks; the mixed ANSI/plain synthetic binding fixture passes.

A fresh immediately healthy stock reboot proved the stronger empirical limit: retained dmesg begins at 17.431607 seconds with no HS-PHY boot marker, while /proc/last_kmsg is tail-only. The stock pair is therefore optional side evidence rather than a manifest gate. If absent, the clock hit/return tuple remains primary and the classifier emits available=false, causal_attribution_permitted=false, an empty comparison list, and comparison_count=0.

The focused reviewer STOP on the direct derive_manifest helper is closed. evidence_paths and evidence_receipts now independently require either no stock keys or the exact two-key pair and must have identical supply state; matching partial, full-path/partial-receipt, and absent-path/full-receipt cases all raise ManifestError.

The first real P3.03 prepare exposed a common D0 host-selection bug when an unrelated A90 and the exact S22 were both present; it stopped before any target command or F1 arm. D0 v2-2 now normalizes the validated SM-S906N/g0q profile to ADB model:SM_S906N/device:g0q metadata, selects exactly one matching state=device row, and pins serial plus total row count before every later target read. Duplicate or replacement S22 rows fail during inventory, unrelated A90 rows receive no command, and the legacy no-metadata constructor retains exact-one behavior. Both D0 CLI and live prepare/execute use adb_client_for_bundle; live adapter v2-5 and execution-source receipts invalidate stale prepared/result closure.

Reuse of a valid stock baseline under another manifest_id or live_run_id is fail-closed in both generic ready preparation and live verify_bundle; the current integration negative returns failure and leaves the canonical manifest absent.
P3.03 adapter promotion restores inherited globals; the current P3.02 regression exercises the actual P3.01-r1 path in the same process and passes.
